A catalog entry is an `<article data-title="...">` containing exactly one `<a class="detail" href="...">` and optionally one `<meta name="summary" content="...">`. A pagination edge is `<a rel="next" href="...">`. Traverse pages depth-first by following next links in document order; process a page at most once. Return dictionaries with keys `title`, `link`, and `summary` in encounter order. HTML entities must be decoded by the parser. Missing pages and malformed entries are skipped; a missing summary becomes `''`. Duplicate entries are retained. Raise `ValueError` if `pages`, its keys/values, or `start` have invalid types. Empty input or an absent start returns `[]`. Returned dictionaries must be newly allocated and share no mutable objects with the input.

import unittest from collections import OrderedDict from solution import collect_entries class CollectEntriesTests(unittest.TestCase): def test_depth_first_traversal_entities_duplicates_and_order(self): pages = OrderedDict([ ('root', '''
first
left
right '''), ('left', '''
deep cycle '''), ('deep', '
'), ('right', '
'), ]) snapshot = pages.copy() self.assertEqual(collect_entries(pages, 'root'), [ {'title': 'A & B', 'link': '/a?x=1&y=2', 'summary': 'one "quoted" summary'}, {'title': 'No Summary', 'link': '/n', 'summary': ''}, {'title': 'Duplicate', 'link': '/d', 'summary': ''}, {'title': 'Deep', 'link': '/deep', 'summary': ''}, {'title': 'Duplicate', 'link': '/d', 'summary': ''}, ]) self.assertEqual(pages, snapshot) def test_malformed_articles_are_skipped(self): pages = {'p': '''
'''} self.assertEqual( collect_entries(pages, 'p'), [{'title': 'valid', 'link': '/ok', 'summary': ''}], ) def test_missing_pages_empty_input_and_fresh_results(self): self.assertEqual(collect_entries({}, 'start'), []) self.assertEqual(collect_entries({'other': ''}, 'start'), []) pages = {'p': '
'} first = collect_entries(pages, 'p') second = collect_entries(pages, 'p') self.assertEqual(first, second) self.assertIsNot(first, second) self.assertIsNot(first[0], second[0]) def test_missing_linked_page_is_skipped(self): pages = {'p': '
'} self.assertEqual(collect_entries(pages, 'p'), [{'title': 'T', 'link': 'L', 'summary': ''}]) def test_invalid_types(self): invalid_calls = [ lambda: collect_entries([], 'x'), lambda: collect_entries({1: '

'}, 'x'), lambda: collect_entries({'x': b'

'}, 'x'), lambda: collect_entries({'x': ''}, 1), ] for call in invalid_calls: with self.assertRaises(ValueError): call() if __name__ == '__main__': unittest.main()
